faq.q: What is the maximum number of passengers on a Marbella boat rental?
faq.a: The largest yachts in our fleet, such as the Mangusta 80, Ferretti 94, and Canados 86, carry up to 12 passengers. This is the legal maximum for most of our charter boats, ensuring comfort and safety. Smaller boats like the Dubhe and Mariah SX21 take 5 passengers.

faq.q: Which boat is best for a group of 10 in Marbella?
faq.a: For 10 passengers, the Azimut 39 (11 pax), Fairline Targa 12m (10 pax), Pershing 46 (10 pax), or Lagoon 380 (10 pax) are ideal. Each offers ample deck space and comfort. If you prefer a larger yacht, consider the Mangusta 80, which takes 12 and includes a free jet ski.

faq.q: Can I bring more passengers than the stated limit?
faq.a: No, the limits are strictly enforced for safety and insurance reasons. Exceeding the maximum invalidates your charter and insurance. Always book a boat that matches your group size, or split into two boats if needed.

faq.q: Do children count towards the passenger limit?

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?

data.body_html:
Planning a group trip to Marbella in 2044? The first thing to sort is passenger capacity. Every boat has a legal maximum, and exceeding it isn't just uncomfortable – it's unsafe and invalidates your insurance. This guide breaks down the exact limits for every boat in our fleet, all departing from Puerto Banús, so you can pick the right charter for your group size and budget.

Why passenger limits matter in Marbella

Spanish maritime law caps the number of passengers based on each vessel's safety certificate, lifejacket storage, and stability. Going over the limit means the skipper cannot legally leave port, and your insurance is void. Our fleet ranges from 5 to 12 passengers, so there's a boat for every group – from a couple's sunset cruise to a 12-person celebration. Always book based on your headcount, including children.

Small groups (5–8 passengers)

For an intimate day out, the Dubhe (5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (5 pax) are perfect for couples or small families. The Speedboat and Red Tide take 6, while the Bandido handles 8. These boats are nimble and ideal for zipping along the coast to Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. Pricing is on request via WhatsApp, so message us with your date and group size.

Mid-size groups (9–11 passengers)

The Astondoa 40 (9 pax) and Azimut 39 (11 pax) are our Tier A boats, priced at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours – skipper, drinks, snacks, and IVA included. For 10 passengers, the Fairline Targa 12m, Pershing 46, or Lagoon 380 are excellent choices. The Lagoon 380 is a catamaran, offering extra stability and space for socialising.

Large groups (12 passengers)

If you're celebrating with a full dozen, the Mangusta 80 (white or grey) is our flagship option, from €4,719 for 4 hours, with a jet ski included free. Other 12-pax yachts include the Azimut 58 Flybridge, Canados 86, Ferretti 94, K80, and Maiora 26m. These superyachts offer luxurious decks, spacious salons, and crew to cater to your every need. All depart from Puerto Banús.

What's included on every charter

  • Licensed skipper and fuel
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks and insurance
  • Safety equipment and Spanish IVA (21%)

No hidden extras – just turn up and enjoy. For the Mangusta 80, a jet ski is also part of the deal.

How to book for your group

For Tier A boats, you can book directly online. For all other vessels, pricing is on request – message us on WhatsApp with your preferred date, duration, and group size, and we'll confirm availability within hours. All boats depart from Puerto Banús, just a short walk from Marbella's Golden Mile. Explore our full range of [Marbella boat rental options](/) to compare boats and find your perfect fit.

Frequently asked questions

What is the maximum number of passengers on a Marbella boat rental?

The largest yachts in our fleet, such as the Mangusta 80, Ferretti 94, and Canados 86, carry up to 12 passengers. This is the legal maximum for most of our charter boats, ensuring comfort and safety. Smaller boats like the Dubhe and Mariah SX21 take 5 passengers.

Which boat is best for a group of 10 in Marbella?

For 10 passengers, the Azimut 39 (11 pax), Fairline Targa 12m (10 pax), Pershing 46 (10 pax), or Lagoon 380 (10 pax) are ideal. Each offers ample deck space and comfort. If you prefer a larger yacht, consider the Mangusta 80, which takes 12 and includes a free jet ski.

Can I bring more passengers than the stated limit?

No, the limits are strictly enforced for safety and insurance reasons. Exceeding the maximum invalidates your charter and insurance. Always book a boat that matches your group size, or split into two boats if needed.

Do children count towards the passenger limit?

Yes, infants and children count as passengers. The limits are set by the boat's safety certificate and lifejacket capacity. For a family with kids, choose a boat with enough margin, like the Azimut 58 Flybridge (12 pax) or the Lagoon 380 (10 pax).

What is included in the charter price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). There are no hidden costs. For the Mangusta 80, a jet ski is also included free.

Are there any extra charges for larger groups?

No, the price is per boat, not per person. The Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, regardless of how many passengers (up to the limit). For other boats, pricing is on request via WhatsApp.

Which boats depart from Puerto Banús?

All boats in our fleet depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella. This includes the Astondoa 40, Azimut 39, Mangusta 80, Ferretti 94, and every other vessel listed. You'll meet your skipper at the marina, and boarding takes about 15 minutes.
